title: H3XY/AGI: quantum text classifier with fair classical baselines and IBM hardware study
description: Code, data pipelines, result files and IBM Quantum job identifiers for the classical-data part of "Small Quantum Classifiers Under Matched Classical and Hardware Tests: Pre-Registered Benchmarks, Fourier Surrogates and IBM Heron Runs": a 4-qubit data re-uploading classifier on sentence embeddings (sentiment, CVE severity), tuned classical baselines, a pre-registered confirmatory evaluation on untouched data, a circuit-design ablation, and a 200-input hardware study on ibm_marrakesh with exact shot-noise statistics, plus a cross-device replication on ibm_kingston and ibm_fez, and a dequantization check with classical Fourier surrogates of the circuit; v1.0.5 adds a 10-seed sensitivity analysis of the confirmatory evaluation and the dequantization check (specified before running).
